items.title: Exploring AWS Lambda Web Functions for building web applications
items.summary: Run a standard Node.js web server on AWS Lambda with Lambda Web Functions, a new type of Lambda function. Deploy it with one command or AWS CloudFormation and get a public HTTPS endpoint with no adapter layer and no servers to manage. See how one execution environment handles many concurrent requests and how active-CPU billing keeps the cost of waiting low.
items.creator: Julian Wood
